title: Exploreaneer
description: exploreaneer aims to make minecraft exploration more fun and exsiting.
body:
exploreaneer aims to improve minecrafts exploration expirience by adding new bosses tools and structures.

it also completely overhauls the end and nether adding new biomes structures monsters and much much more

![dungeons and taverns structure preveiw](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f63284ebd0587a88df9d140da072846d82ec586e.webp)

new stuff
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
1. brand new structures in end, nether and overworld
2. new way to get to the end
3. new end islands
4. yungs structure series 
5. all original dungeons and taverns structures
6. dungeons and taverns end castle
7. a plethora of naturaly generating structures

</details>
stuff only included in version 1.10
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
1. moogs structure series
2. an upgrade to the villages and villagers
3. much more quality of life mods
4. bug fixes and more

</details>
